rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; pre-training on TractoInferno dataset from 6 sites; fine-tuning on NIMHANS cohort from 2 scanners (Philips Ingenia and Siemens Skyra)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32], acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites." ; "We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences) cohort"

rci2_using_epd.detail: TractoInferno is a publicly available dataset but is not on the established 18 EPD list; NIMHANS is an in-house cohort from India
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32]" ; "We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences) cohort"

rci3_epd_name.detail: RCI-2 = No; no EPD from the established list was used for NM reference cohort construction

model-1.model-name: Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) model for WM tract geometry and microstructure

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; two-stage training: (1) generative pre-training on 198 healthy subjects from TractoInferno (6 sites) for 29,000 steps; (2) fine-tuning on 50 CN subjects randomly selected from NIMHANS, stratified by sex and scanner, for 5,000 steps
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32], acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites." ; "Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset, randomly selected and stratified by sex and scanner, were then used to fine-tune the model for 5000 steps."
